court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
trial_court: Family Court, case number: Family Court Appeal No. 189 of 2008
outcome_detected: the order of the trial Court in this behalf is confirmed
facts_of_case: The respondent instituted proceedings for dissolving the marriage between herself and the appellant. The trial court initially decided in favour of the respondent, but the appeal was allowed and the matter was remanded to the trial court. After remand, the trial court allowed the petition and dissolved the marriage by decree of divorce.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party alleging cruelty to prove the same.
legal_principles.held: It is his contention that after the respondent left the matrimonial home on 24th April, 2000, she returned not on 15th May, 2000, but on 14th July 2000, only to carry her belongings, including Stridhan.

legal_principles.principle: A receipt executed in the presence of a Police Constable and the father can be considered as evidence.
legal_principles.held: She gave a writing to the effect that she had taken away all the belongings, ornaments, jewelery etc.

outcome.final_order: The order of the trial Court in this behalf is confirmed.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for divorce under Hindu Marriage Act
responding to a petition for divorce in family court
appealing a decree of divorce in Bombay High Court
